params.name: type
params.description: Type of system folder whose pathname to return; defaults to the active System folder if omitted.

sentinelValues.meaning: System (default if omitted): active System folder
User preferences_all: preferences folder shared by all users
User preferences_user: preferences folder customized for the current user
Startup Win_all (Windows only; returns an empty string on macOS)
Startup Win_user (Windows only; returns an empty string on macOS)
Start menu Win_all (Windows only; returns an empty string on macOS)
Start menu Win_user (Windows only; returns an empty string on macOS)
System Win (Windows only; returns an empty string on macOS)
System32 Win (Windows only; returns an empty string on macOS)
Favorites Win (Windows only; returns an empty string on macOS)
Home folder: current home folder of the user

constraints: Constants suffixed 'Win' are usable on Windows only; when used on macOS, the command returns an empty string.
Constants 2-9 come in _all/_user pairs, selecting between a folder shared by all users vs. one customized for the current user.
